items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:151:1
items.html: Other MaNTzePaCh, and the Gevurot were now renewed and sweetened, etc., and are drawn to the Nukva throughout the nine days of repentance. This has already been explained in Part 9. And there are here three discernments of MaNTzePaCh, which are: the first, the MaNTzePaCh of Katnut [smallness/infancy] that she receives from ZA at the time when she is with him back to back from the Chazeh [chest] downward, and they are harsh judgments. And the second, the MaNTzePaCh of Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] that she takes from Ima not by way of ZA, which are sweetened. The third, the MaNTzePaCh of Gadlut that she takes by way of ZA, in which there is the most complete sweetening. See there, page 781, item 73; page 798, item 95; and page 840, answer 71. Except that the ARI abbreviated his language here.
